title: conioselinum smithii
intro: Conioselinum smithii, commonly known as Wild Angelica, is a perennial plant native to East Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Wild Angelica include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and spasmolytic properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
